parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the acceleration of free fall g using a pendulum. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 A pendulum has been set up for you as shown in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Adjust the length of the pendulum until the distance d measured to the centre of the bob is 50.0 cm. Displace the bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Fig. 1.2 shows one complete oscillation of the pendulum.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. T = .......................................................... [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the acceleration of free fall g using the equation g = 20 T 2 . g = .......................................................... [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Adjust the pendulum until the distance d measured to the centre of the bob is 100.0 cm.
